newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly weaker in after-hours trade on Wednesday as moderate profit-taking emerged, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.5 yen per kg lower, with the benchmark May contract ending down 0.2 yen at 144.4 yen.
During the day, firmer Thai rubber offer prices to Japan provided support. Volume was 5,828 lots.
"One focus point is whether rainfall in Thailand will be prolonged and have an impact on the rubber tapping process," one trader said.
